labelRules.scope: overall stratum; also reported per stratum
labelRules.pairRule: DEPTH-SPECIFIC_DIFFERENCE_OBSERVED for Dxx vs D15 if |median delta| > tie AND the fraction of non-tied pairs sharing the median sign >= 2/3; otherwise NO_CLEAR_DEPTH-SPECIFIC_DIFFERENCE; direction reported descriptively
labelRules.overallRule: DEPTH_SENSITIVITY_OBSERVED if any of the three pairs is DEPTH-SPECIFIC_DIFFERENCE_OBSERVED; otherwise NO_CLEAR_DEPTH_SENSITIVITY

statements: STEP 27 Phase B is a descriptive within-product depth sensitivity experiment; no significance, causal or operational claim is made.
The only intentional difference between D05, D10, D15 and D20 is the native ocean velocity depth (5.078224 / 9.572997 / 15.810070 / 18.495560 m); labels are target labels only.
The depth set and the control D15 were fixed before execution; no depth was added, removed, interpolated, weighted or chosen after results.
Holdout results are descriptive only and were not used to choose or re-rank a depth.
No preferred operational depth is declared; alpha = 0.002 and STEP 20-26 are unchanged.
